slides.title: KINEMATICS: WHICH EQUATION DO I USE?

Choose the equation that has no unknown extras
Keep units in meters and seconds
slides.note: Write v₀, v, a, t and Δx before you choose.

slides.problem: A car starts from rest and accelerates at 2 m/s² for 5 s. Find v.

slides.problem: Same car. How far does it travel in those 5 s?
